title: Ev-Edge: Efficient Execution of Event-based Vision Algorithms on Commodity Edge Platforms
problem: Event-based vision algorithms (ANNs, SNNs, hybrid models) suffer from poor performance and utilization on commodity edge platforms with heterogeneous processing elements due to mismatch between irregular event stream characteristics and hardware architecture.
motivation: Event cameras enable high temporal resolution and dynamic range for autonomous navigation, but current edge hardware lacks efficient support for the diverse algorithms required to process asynchronous event data.
method: Ev-Edge makes event-based vision work on edge hardware through three optimizations. It converts the raw event stream into sparse frames (compact representations with mostly zero values), which lets it use existing optimized sparse libraries. It then combines multiple frames at runtime to better utilize all available processors, accepting slightly coarser time resolution in exchange for better hardware efficiency. Finally, it distributes computation across heterogeneous hardware elements (CPUs, GPUs, and specialized accelerators) and chooses the numerical precision for each layer based on the cost of computation versus data movement.
key_novelty: The single core idea is dynamically combining sparse frames while optimizing task distribution across heterogeneous processors and selecting per-layer numerical precision at runtime to bridge the mismatch between irregular event streams and commodity edge hardware.
contributions: Event2Sparse Frame converter for efficient sparse representation of raw event streams with minimal encoding overhead
Dynamic Sparse Frame Aggregator for runtime optimization through temporal-computational demand tradeoffs
Network Mapper for heterogeneous processor allocation and layer-wise precision selection
1.28x-2.05x latency and 1.23x-2.15x energy improvements demonstrated on NVIDIA Jetson Xavier AGX
baselines: all-GPU baseline on NVIDIA Jetson Xavier AGX
primary_theme: efficient event-based vision on edge platforms
